run_FourDGTDemo_inference: run 4DGT model inference on input images and cameras to render output views
run_FourDGTDemo_async_inference: run asynchronous 4DGT inference with parallel Gaussian generation and rendering from a dataloader
run_FourDGTDemo_process_batch: process a single dataloader batch through the 4DGT model with optional frame saving
run_FourDGTDemo_render_from_saved: render frames from previously saved Gaussian parameters without re-encoding input images
run_FourDGTDemo_encode: encode input images and camera parameters into 3D Gaussian splatting parameters
